steps.text: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
Of course
Why are you asking?
Because I keep thinking about it
I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
That's not true, you are more capable than you think
And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
I will be there to help you with everything you need
I know, and I really appreciate that
But I can't help but worry about it a little
That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
But I am confident that you will do great
Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
That makes me feel a little better
Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
Already tomorrow?
That is sooner than I expected
I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
Now you have my attention
I am curious to know what you found
And maybe a little nervous too
That is perfectly normal
We will take it one step at a time
Alright
Then I will wait for your message later 😊
